implementation: Kinematic client road following with continuous pose correction and teleport recovery
legacy_modules: Existing controller / road / lease / surrogate checks retained; they do not prove the new kinematic mode in Roblox.
limitations: Follows available minimap, local map path, or active race data; cannot infer an arbitrary unmarked road.
Waits for a loaded road surface instead of teleporting into empty map geometry.
No live networking, server correction, collision or drift-scoring validation.
Direct position control and open-road turnarounds may be visibly abrupt.
